description: Directive 28: the production entry for config/environments.json once a dedicated DSBC Firebase project exists. Every <PLACEHOLDER> is a value only the App Owner can choose or Firebase can issue (project id, web app config, domain); none is invented. The resolver refuses any target that still contains a placeholder, so this file cannot be built or deployed as it is. See docs/directive-28/PRODUCTION-PROVISIONING.md.

placeholders.<DSBC_PROJECT_ID>: the new project's id, chosen at creation (globally unique, permanent), e.g. a name the owner picks for DSBC production
placeholders.<WEB_APP_ID>: appId of the 'DSBC Web' Firebase web app registered in the new project (firebase apps:create web)
placeholders.<WEB_API_KEY>: apiKey of that web app (public identifier; restrict it to the Firebase APIs and the DSBC origin)
placeholders.<SENDER_ID>: messagingSenderId of that web app (= project number)
placeholders.<DSBC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN>: https://<chosen DSBC domain>, or https://<DSBC_PROJECT_ID>.web.app until a custom domain is connected

secrets.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET: Secret Manager in the new project; a placeholder value set by the owner while payments are disabled
secrets.RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Secret Manager in the new project; a placeholder value set by the owner while payments are disabled
